† [עָקַשׁ] vb. twist (NH id. (rare));—
Niph. Pt. cstr. נֶעְקַשׁ דְּרָכַיִם Pr 28:18 one crooked in ways (< pl., cf. Toy).
Pi. Pf. 3 pl. עִקְּשׁוּ לָהֶם Is 59:8 their paths they have twisted. Impf. 3 mpl. יְעַקֵּ֑שׁוּ Mi 3:9 all that is straight they make crooked; Pt. מְעַקֵּשׁ דְּרָכָיו Pr 10:9 (cf. Niph.).
Hiph. Impf. וַיַּעְקְשֵׁנִי Jb 9:20 (Ges§ 53 n) he hath declared me crooked, devious (in life).
